title: •Tauntaun Bones
caption: •Tauntaun Bones (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Your ferocious creatures are deploy -2 and ferocity +2. Once per turn, may ▲ a Tauntaun or a ferocious creature. Twice per game, may deploy a Tauntaun or a ferocious creature from under your Starting Effect. {alter}
lore: The bones of a tauntaun represent both death and life: death for the prey, life for the predator. A symbol of the ebb and flow of the Force through all things.
